displayName: Action.com Store API - Weekly Deals, Prices by Country, Stores
description: Action API for Action (action.com), the European non-food discount store - this week's Action deals on any of its 19 storefronts in 16 countries with Action's validity dates and week id (deals run Wednesday to Tuesday, e.g. Promo2026Week47, 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-24), the deal price next to the regular price, Belgium's Action Plus loyalty-card deals, and the same article number priced in each market in its own currency (EUR, CHF, PLN, CZK, RON; prices differ per market, even inside the euro zone), up to 60 article numbers per call; keyword search, category, brand, new-arrival and seasonal collection lists (Black Friday, Christmas), 24 per page with total and pages, sorted by price or newest and filtered by department, price band, brand or new; one product in full with specifications and the store aisle; the 20 Action stores nearest a city, postcode or point (they may cross a border) and one store with 7 dated days of opening hours; reviews on the Dutch, German, French and Polish storefronts (local or international, no reviewer names); the category tree, Action's own brands and search suggestions; the Action webshop (shop.action.com, Netherlands and Belgium) with EAN, online stock level, order limit and shipping cost. Data in each storefront's language. 16 endpoints, 1 credit per call. Action does not publish store stock; no price history, leaflets or checkout.
